caption:
bog-mutant redesign, Step 0 (for Aaron's veto).  Concept: pod-carrier_seed412.  Chibi, 4 heads, like blast-diver, drowned-diver and mycologist.
Lore 1. Family C, spore-warped colonist still on shift: a dredge-line worker whose back has split open into a clutch of glowing spore pods. He still wears the hood, the pouches and the boots.
Lore 2. Not any other swamp: an heirloom quilted liner parka (G1) that the swamp is fruiting out of, the pods its one glow (G3). At 96 px: a hunched hood under a crown of lit bulbs, not a brute.
Routes at held seeds.  A = anchor off (txt2img, prompt from the concept).  I = the concept as IPAdapter ref (style transfer, weight 0.5, end_at 0.7).  Graph: r2 bog-mutant raw, texts swapped.
